verdict.rationale: Khoj is a self-hostable assistant server, so outbound webhook subscriptions are a fair axis to ask about, but the evidence documents no registrable HTTP callbacks. Automations deliver results by email on a schedule, which is an adjacent notification feature and not a webhook a programmatic consumer can receive. The WhatsApp client is a chat channel and does not qualify either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
